target.title: docs: document local text worker pattern
target.body:
Closes #51333

## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a docs gap where users mixing hosted and local models had to infer the cloud-orchestrator plus local-text-workers pattern from several separate pages.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds a focused Gateway docs page that frames hosted models as the tool-using orchestrator and local models as bounded text workers for drafting, summarizing, rewriting, or JSON-only tasks. The page composes existing local model, CLI backend, sub-agent, llm-task, timeout, and sandbox guidance without changing runtime behavior or adding config.

## User Impact

Users can now find one recommended pattern for using local models safely as text-in/text-out workers while keeping tool use, approvals, and final decisions with a reliable orchestrator model.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: the new docs page is registered, parses as MDX, and has valid internal links.
- Head SHA: 7437758e60cd3adb7ccd19656735923dc41d58c3
- Commands / artifacts:
  - `git diff --check`
  - `git diff --cached --check`
  - `node scripts/docs-list.js | Select-String -Pattern "local-text-workers|Local text workers"`
  - `node scripts/check-docs-mdx.mjs docs README.md`
  - `node scripts/docs-link-audit.mjs`
  - `node scripts/check-docs-i18n-glossary.mjs --base upstream/main --head HEAD`
- Observed result:
  - docs list includes `gateway\\local-text-workers.md`
  - MDX passed for 694 files
  - link audit reported `broken_links=0`
  - i18n glossary check passed with no missing-term output
- Not tested / proof gaps:
  - No live Mintlify browser render captured.
  - No runtime behavior changed.
